fees.notes: Monash Malaysia official 2026 fee schedule (international annual tuition); Malaysian RM43,200/year. 6% service tax applies to international students from 1 Jul 2025. Source: https://www.monash.edu.my/study/undergraduate/fees

requirements.english_requirement: IELTS 6.5 (no band less than 6.0) or TOEFL iBT 79 or PTE 58
requirements.other_qualifications: Completed Australian bachelor's degree (or equivalent) with minimum overall WAM 75; distinction average (75%) in 24 credit points at level three; interview and dissertation proposal required (WAM 70-75 may be considered)
